cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Try It First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to test the shortcut, substitute, or questionable fix before you rely on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Taste this cheap coffee substitute before I fill my cup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. If you like this, we can save the proper stuff for guests.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not sacrificing breakfast to save you money.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One sip. If it's awful, I'll buy you a croissant and keep my cup empty.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 protect a pleasant breakfast and question the unnecessary substitute.

heightening.evidence: A5 narrows B exposure and offers compensation while retaining A own untouched cup.

specificity.evidence: A1 substitute and empty cup establish the asymmetrical experiment.
